newsitem.title: ALBANIA: "Erect the gallows!", Albania women say.
newsitem.headline: "Erect the gallows!", Albania women say.

text.p: A group of women, wailing as Albanian police broke up a rally in Tirana on Wednesday, voiced desperation over losing their money in failed pyramid investment schemes by saying there was nothing left but to hang themselves.
Thousands of people in Europe's poorest country have been left facing ruin after they sold homes and livelihoods to invest in get-rich-quick schemes, without being made fully aware of the dangers.
"A gallows should be erected in the centre of Tirana so we can all hang ourselves like the man in Fieri...we've been left out in the street," a 45-year-old widow called Lume said.
She was referring to newspaper reports of a man in the southern town of Fieri who hanged himself on Monday after learning he had lost all his money.

The Gazeta Shqiptare daily said the 50-year-old man left a suicide note saying he had invested money in two failed pyramid schemes, ploughing in cash from the sale of his house and car and money his son had earned abroad.

The Tirana widow was among a number of women who had put money in a pyramid scheme run by a gypsy woman called Sude who was arrested after admitting she could no longer pay out millions of dollars invested in her fund.

The ruling right-wing government has frozen funds from two failed schemes -- Xhaferi and Populli -- which were placed on account in state banks. This cash will be given back to investors but not money invested in the Sude scheme.
"What should we who have invested in Sude do? Hang ourselves in the centre of Tirana?" the widow asked.
She said she had invested the 20 million leks ($20,000) she got from selling her apartment. She had not received a cent back and had two children to bring up.
"Nothing is left to me but to get a tent and live out in the open," she added.
The group of women, who had gathered for the anti-government rally with some 200 others, were roughly jostled by police officers who broke up the protest.
They cried openly before running away as a police van bore down on them.
